english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something literally unbelievable or astonishing.
Use this when the emphasis is that an event or claim is so extraordinary that it is hard to believe, rather than literally impossible to imagine.
Use this more formal expression for something impossible to believe, especially in emphatic reactions or writing.

examples.traditional: 呢個結果真係難以置信。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 zan1 hai6 naan4 ji5 zi3 seon3

examples.english: It is unimaginable that he made so much money in just one hour.
examples.traditional: 佢一個鐘頭就賺到咁多錢，真係難以置信。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 go3 zung1 tau4 zau6 zaan6 dou3 gam3 do1 cin4 zan1 hai6 naan4 ji5 zi3 seon3

examples.english: It is unbelievable that the accident injured so many people.
examples.traditional: 事故造成咁多人受傷，實在難以置信。
examples.jyutping: si6 gu3 zou6 sing4 gam3 do1 jan4 sau6 soeng1 sat6 zoi6 naan4 ji5 zi3 seon3
